column1: # Two-sided contract evidence. Format: contract-id|polarity|exact Rust test name
# Every contract MUST carry at least one positive and one negative test.
# `supporting` evidence may supplement a pair but never replaces either side.
# New or renamed Rust tests must be registered here; existing unclassified
# tests are frozen in contracts-baseline.txt and cannot grow.
# A21/M7 authority declaration plus grant-event activation
# Operator ledger inspection: listings expose signed event time and full
# records; invalid inspection targets fail without creating or changing state.
# W-2 unified gate replay: the decision evaluator re-runs over signed
# records, clocked at each event's `at` (SI-22 at-the-time semantics).
# W-9 foreign-trace corpus harness: conversion fails closed (quarantine
# leaves NOTHING in the substrate), and the pure replay is the
# A22/§5.4 capability closure: event-derived liveness at the durable
# authorization offset, shared by decision time and gate replay; permanent,
# prospective, descendant-closing; doubt never widens on either edge.
